git_commit_note: The commit immediately preceding the one that adds this file — the tree that was actually built and measured. See benchmarks/tpch/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md.

methodology.note: Only the engine being measured was running; the others were stopped, not left idle. An idle engine still holds its heap — three Trino JVMs declare -Xmx8G each — so an all-up arrangement measures every engine under memory pressure from its rivals, and at sf10 the combined ceiling exceeds the 15.67 GiB the container runtime has. Both scale factors use this arrangement so their figures are comparable.
methodology.runner_isolation: The benchmark runner is containerized because the DataFusion adapter runs in-process inside it; a host-side runner would measure DataFusion natively against containerized rivals.

notes: arneb ran in its default configuration: zero ARNEB_* tuning variables, verified with docker inspect against the running container rather than the compose file.
Numbers are arm64 macOS figures from one laptop. They are reproducible on comparable hardware; they do not generalize to Linux x86 servers.
